name: usage-statement
title: Usage statement for review
for_each: select id,month::text as label from statements

sections.title: Statement record
sections.note: This is a usage calculation, not a tax invoice or payment request. Only a separate approval record marks review complete.
sections.sql: select a.name as customer,s.month,s.currency,s.total_cents,s.prepared_by,s.created_at from statements s join accounts a on a.id=s.account_id where s.id=$1

sections.title: Frozen charge lines
sections.sql: select line->>'meter' as meter,line->>'units' as units,line->>'included_units' as included_units,(line->>'charge_cents')::bigint as charge_cents,s.currency from statements s, lateral jsonb_array_elements(s.lines) line where s.id=$1

sections.title: Review record
sections.sql: select reviewed_by,evidence,created_at from approvals where statement_id=$1

sections.title: Record checks
sections.sql: select c.* from compliance_findings c join accounts a on a.code=c.account where a.id=$1

sections.title: Issues and resolutions
sections.sql: select title,owner,due_on,status,resolution from issues where account_id=$1 order by due_on

sections.title: Notes
sections.sql: select actor,body,created_at from notes where account_id=$1 order by created_at
